import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_89/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_89/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_89/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_89/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Extract only the 'video' column from each source
videos0 = source0[['video']]
videos1 = source1[['video']]
videos2 = source2[['video']]
videos3 = source3[['video']]

# Concatenate (union) all video columns vertically
all_videos = pd.concat([videos0, videos1, videos2, videos3], ignore_index=True)

# Drop duplicates to match the target examples (unique videos)
all_videos_unique = all_videos.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Save the result to the target path
all_videos_unique.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
